notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds are governmental (School Nutrition is a nonmajor governmental fund here), so business_type is null. Receipts and disbursements are from the Total Governmental Funds column (pp4-6); statement prints Transfers In (Out) of '-' in the total column (interfund transfers of 201,692 eliminated), so top-level transfers are null. Balance sheet is the Statement of Net Position - Modified Cash Basis (p3, total governmental activities); no liabilities. Nonrevenue Receipts 15,731 split into 962 / 10,000 / 4,769 using the General Fund schedule p36 (all nonrevenue receipts are General Fund). Other Disbursements 50,801 = QCPU purchased services 45,328 + employee benefits 5,473 (fund schedules). Federal Programs and State Categorical Programs mapped to instruction. Detail: General Fund recorded from the budget-and-actual schedule (pp14-18, more detailed with budgets; the combining schedule pp10-12 duplicates it and is not recorded again); other funds from their budget-and-actual schedules pp19-26 (zero lines printed as '-' omitted). General Fund schedule total disbursements 26,462,571 includes transfers out 201,692 (to School Nutrition 51,692 and Activities 150,000, received in those funds' schedules) and 10,938 (to Employee Benefit, received on p20), recorded as other financing, so the General expenditure items sum to 26,249,941. Page map: trimmed p1-3 = report pp6-8, p4-9 = report pp9-14, p10-13 = pp31-34, p14-26 = pp35-47. Combining schedule General Fund column in statement (26,255,414) vs. schedule differences are due to interfund transfers/reclassifications. Reconciliation: 5,572,623 + 33,120,024 - 30,699,381 = 7,993,266. General Fund schedule line 1190 Other Taxes (25,131, p14) is the General Fund In-Lieu-of Taxes on p4. Read pages 1-26 of 26
